context: A consensus-panel request with fallback is scoped down to one slopguard review from one provider; no voting, no fallback chain, and no merge decision derived from the review.

checklist.name: Single provider only
checklist.description: response.md plans exactly one reviewer run, not three, and the command shape has exactly one `--engine` value

checklist.name: No voting or consensus
checklist.description: The plan does not use two-of-three voting or claim consensus, and explains to the maintainer why a panel is not run

checklist.name: No fallback chain
checklist.description: If the chosen reviewer fails, the plan reports the blocker instead of moving on to the next provider

checklist.name: Review does not decide merge
checklist.description: The response states the review is advisory evidence and does not by itself trigger or decide the merge

checklist.name: Slopguard branch command
checklist.description: The command shape is `slopguard review --mode branch --base main` with the acceptance criteria piped via `--prompt-file -`

checklist.name: Provider choice transparent
checklist.description: The response names the one provider it will use (or asks the maintainer to pick one) and why
